query.text: 请帮我看着他们抬轮椅，结束后总结一下情况。
query.text_en: Please help me watch them lift the wheelchair, and summarize the situation once they are finished.

annotation.text_zh: 两人配合，轮椅抬上又安全抬下。
annotation.text_en: Working together, they safely carried the wheelchair up and down.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
